decisions.reason: Ending the monthly quota does not establish a new duration rule or resolve the existing ambiguity about shorter clip styles.
The source ends the contract and quota but does not change which source materials are permitted or required for clips.
The quota removal does not alter the requirement that produced clips contain complete, standalone lessons, stories, or points.
The source does not replace or cancel any specific submission channel, folder convention, batch rule, or review-link procedure.
The contract termination does not retroactively modify the previously defined qualification method or its success criteria.
Removing the monthly quota does not change the clean-editing, effects, or transition standards.
The same source already establishes and reports failure of the communication expectation; quota removal does not modify that expectation.
The source does not change any caption color, font, effect, lettering, or positioning rule.
The quota removal does not modify the standard for selecting strong and impactful source moments.
The source contains no decision about wind-noise removal or any other audio-cleanup behavior.
